meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 扫描项目中未被引用的代码,用 LSP 引用查询逐个核实后,派多个并行 agent 按文件分组删除,每组通过类型检查才单独提交一次 commit,最后给出删除与跳过清单。
howto.when: 当你提到「remove dead code」「dead code」「cleanup」等关键词,或要求清理项目里没用到的代码时触发。

say.text: 扫描整个项目里的未使用代码,先列出候选给我
say.note: 只列出候选,不直接删除

say.text: 只清理 src/utils 目录下的死代码
say.note: 给参数可把扫描范围缩到该目录

say.text: 把确认无用的导出函数和类型删掉并提交
say.note: 每个文件单独一次原子提交

howto.what_en: Claude scans your project for unused code, verifies each candidate with LSP reference lookups, then dispatches parallel agents to remove them in file-based batches, each committing separately only after typecheck passes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "remove dead code", "dead code", "cleanup" and similar keywords, or ask to clean up unused code in the project.

say_en.text: Scan the whole project for unused code and list the candidates first
say_en.note: Lists candidates only, removes nothing yet

say_en.text: Only clean up dead code under src/utils
say_en.note: Passing a scope narrows the scan to that place

say_en.text: Delete the confirmed unused exported functions and types, then commit
